question: What is the current release of the Human Protein Atlas, what new data did it add, and how many antibodies and human genes does the atlas cover in this release?

tool_uses.name: web_search
tool_uses.input: {"query":"site:proteinatlas.org Human Protein Atlas current release new data antibodies human genes release"}

tool_uses.name: web_search
tool_uses.input: {"query":"Human Protein Atlas release 25 antibodies genes new data"}

turns.text:
The **current Human Protein Atlas release is version 25.1**, released **May 25, 2026** (Ensembl version 109). The release added:

- **Deep Visual Proteomics (DVP)** data to the Single Cell resource: mass-spectrometry-based protein profiles covering **27 cell types/shapes from 14 tissues**, with RNA–protein comparisons.
- **Bulk-tissue quantitative proteomics** data integrated into the Tissue resource, covering **20 tissue types** and protein profiles for **more than 12,700 genes**.

Source: [HPA release history](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/releases#25.1)

For coverage, the release-history page gives the headline totals for the corresponding major release **25.0**: **more than 27,800 antibodies**, targeting proteins from **more than 17,400 human genes**—approximately **88% of human protein-coding genes**. The 25.1 entry does not provide a new exact total, so these are the latest stated Atlas-wide coverage figures available on that page.

Source: [HPA release history](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/releases#25.0)
